# NUXA

NUXA is a digital platform operated by EMPORDAJOBS SL with conversational tools and general information related to emotional wellbeing. NUXA is not a psychologist, clinical service, or emergency service. Its tools do not provide a diagnosis or replace care from a qualified health professional. No claim of clinical efficacy, professional review, certification, guaranteed confidentiality, or guaranteed security is made here.
